title: 2-Hour Stand Up Paddleboard Rental from Lake Buena Vista Area
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Minors must have parent or guardian with them at all times
Recommended Dress Code: swimwear, activewear or dry-fit clothing
Reservations are available at 9:00am, 10:00 am and 11:00 am
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Your 2-hour Stand up Paddle Board rental includes life jackets and paddles. Leave from a private beach and enjoy the natural, scenic beauty of Lake Bryan, a 450 acre spring fed lake tucked behind the Lake Buena Vista area.  Complementary lesson for beginners included.
